profile.headline: Enterprise Web Developer/Scrum Master
profile.summary:
I have worked in the banking industry for nine years now. During that time I have become adept at pivoting, being agile and always a team player. 

I obtained my scrum master certification in December 2017. Since then I have worked on small and large projects. I have conducted daily standups and sprint planning meetings. I have created user stories, refined backlogs, and also held the very important retrospective in order to learn and grow as a team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: Kanban · Knowledge Acquisition · User Acceptance Testing · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Negotiation · Communication · Entity Framework · User Stories · Version Control

positions.title: Web Applications Developer
positions.description: Currently developing in an Agile team environment on an enterprise MVC web application using WCF as well as creating custom user controls utilizing c#, asp.net, AJAX, jQuery, Web Services and XML data storage as well as writing RESTful web services to interact with data in the Amazon S3 cloud storage system.

positions.title: Microsoft Certified Developer
positions.description: Worked independently on developing web sites for small companies.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: I built custom desktop applications using VB6  code as well as maintaining the legacy code.

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description:
Defined financial goals and developed and controlled a budget. 
Handled customer issues/complaints with careful communication and active listening to accomplish positive outcomes.  
Provided inventory management and organization of products.
Informed clients of their choices in order to encourage them to make an educated decision about products and services.
Established sales goals and maintained records of communications and purchases.
Maintained customer relations through consistent correspondence.

volunteerExperiences.description: Building a website for a start up non profit which provides continuing education to intellectually challenged young adults using HTML5, Angular.js and Backbone.js on an MVC framework to allow for future expansion.

projects.title: AWS Data Storage
projects.description: Utilizing Amazon's proprietary SDK which encapsulates their web api, I created a proxy class to Create Update and Delete data from the Amazon S3 data storage in their cloud architecture.
